body:
Okay, have done so many illegal and legal drugs. Pointless to venture there. I am taking Lyrica 150/300mg's for crippling anxiety.
Received 1g of BK-2CB. first day, doled out 3x35mg parcels, +0:30 nothing. +2:00 eat second wrap. +3:00 slight chills. +4:00 eat third wrap, chills, something about to start..not really.  Have to call it a day.
day 2
I figured there might be some manner of tolerance buildup, dosing too soon again. But I need to figure out what this stuff does. proceed to make 100mg wraps. Eat first one. +2:00 nothing yet, taking another 100mg's. +4:00 chills, taking another 100mg. +6:00 chills, something about to start. another 100 mg's. +8:00 chills, slight fuzziness in vision, clear mind. take another 100mg.
Need to urinate, shriveled penor. Very good sign. Floor is warbling nicely. Decide that I have dosed enough. No body load besides slight pressure in neck. Scalp tingly and then some.
Recline onto couch to watch the wooden panelling morph into earthy tones. No feeling of weirdness or out-of-it headspace. I could definitely go to the bank and meet people and they'd never know I'm on anything. Not that I would, keeping it safe.
This stuff is very lucid to me, just visually pleasing. No though-patterns or revelations. Just eye-candy. Something between Ecstacy and mushrooms, without weirdness or special entactogen feel to it.
I'd like to wait a week and try it with a single dose of 100mg. This stuff doesn't feel toxic or in any way easily over-dosable to me.
